title: Build complete folder management system with nested folders and navigation

requirements.text: Implement backend folder hierarchy supporting unlimited nesting depth with parent-child relationships tracked via folderId field in folder metadata

quotes: should users be able to create nested folders (folders within folders)

acceptanceCriteria: Folders can be created with a parent folderId parameter
Folders with null or empty folderId are root-level folders
Backend query methods filter folders by parent folderId to retrieve children of a specific folder
Folder deletion handles nested children according to user choice (recursive delete or move to parent)

requirements.text: Add backend query method to retrieve folder path from root to current folder for breadcrumb display

quotes: Should there be a "back" button, breadcrumbs showing the path

acceptanceCriteria: Method accepts a folderId and returns ordered array of folder objects from root to target
Array includes folder id, name, and parent relationship for each ancestor
Root folder (null parent) is included as first element

requirements.text: Implement folder navigation state management tracking current folderId in frontend, allowing users to navigate into folders by clicking them

quotes: click on a each created folder - not change to there file display area

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a folder updates the current folderId state
File display area shows only files belonging to the current folderId
Folder list shows only direct children of current folderId
Navigation state persists during component lifecycle

requirements.text: Add breadcrumb navigation component showing full folder path from root to current location with clickable links to navigate to any ancestor folder

quotes: Should there be a "back" button, breadcrumbs showing the path

acceptanceCriteria: Breadcrumbs display complete folder hierarchy from root to current folder
Each breadcrumb segment is clickable and navigates to that folder level
Breadcrumb separator visually indicates hierarchy (e.g., '/' or '>')
Current folder is highlighted or styled differently from ancestors

requirements.text: Add back button that navigates to the parent folder of the current location

quotes: Should there be a "back" button, breadcrumbs showing the path

acceptanceCriteria: Back button is visible when user is not at root level
Clicking back button navigates to parent folder
Back button is disabled or hidden when at root level
Back button includes appropriate icon (e.g., arrow left)

requirements.text: Ensure file upload functionality works within any folder by passing current folderId to upload operation

quotes: can be upload file in them area

acceptanceCriteria: File upload component accepts current folderId as parameter
Uploaded files are associated with the current folderId in metadata
Files uploaded in a folder only appear when viewing that specific folder
Upload progress and success messages indicate the target folder

requirements.text: Ensure files are isolated to their specific folder location and only appear in the file display when that folder is actively selected

quotes: should files only appear in the specific folder where they were uploaded

acceptanceCriteria: File queries filter by current folderId to show only files in that folder
Files uploaded to folder A do not appear when viewing folder B
Root-level files (no folderId) only appear at root level
Moving a file updates its folderId to the new location

requirements.text: Fix folder creation in My Folder section to properly display newly created folders in the folder list immediately after creation

quotes: When clicked on the "My Folder" section, not showing up the created folder in the file display area

acceptanceCriteria: Creating a new folder triggers immediate cache invalidation and refetch of folder list
Newly created folder appears in the folder list without requiring page refresh
Folder creation mutation returns the created folder object for optimistic updates
Error states are handled and displayed if folder creation fails

requirements.text: Maintain separate independent storage areas for My Files section (root-level files with no folder) and My Folder section (organized folder hierarchy)

quotes: They are two complete different sections

acceptanceCriteria: My Files section displays only files with null or empty folderId
My Folder section displays folder hierarchy and files within folders
Files uploaded in My Files remain separate from My Folder contents
Navigation between sections is clear and maintains separate state

constraints: Use existing backend/main.mo single-actor architecture without creating additional backend files
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Use React Query for all data fetching and mutations with proper cache invalidation
Follow existing file metadata structure with folderId field for folder association
Maintain existing folder color, visibility, and collaboration features from current implementation
nonGoals: Real-time collaboration or live updates to folder contents
Folder permissions separate from existing file permissions system
Folder templates or preset folder structures
Folder favorites or pinning functionality separate from file favorites
